$Comment: Bram's Apprentice: bring down logs from any trees, and from then on every Christmas Present the player
opens rolls once more for a decoration (Lootables/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Bram_Present.json). It is one
of the two keys to his secret (Factors/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Bram_Key.json), the one that works on
every server; a server running MMO Skill Tree also opens it at Woodcutting level 20. The _Christmas
folder makes the id christmas_bram_apprentice, which the key reads once it is collected.
Npc binds it to Bram by the id his placement keeps in both seasons (Harvest_Feast_Shepherd), and the
base's Npc.TurnInId adds the report-back step to him. It opens once his part of Santa's story
(christmas_reindeer_food) is done, and never repeats. BREAK_BLOCK counts each trunk block broken: CONTAINS
on _Trunk takes every tree's trunk, and the library never counts a block the player placed.
Listing.MainLine false keeps it off the story's gold bar.
It pays like Tomas's Apprentice (Tomas_Apprentice.json), with MMO Skill Tree's Woodcutting XP behind its
own row gate. Its words come from the keys its id spells, in christmas.mmo.lang.
Name: Bram_Apprentice
